scope: Source and focused synthetic/private physical controls only; no trained-policy evaluation, optimization, native outcome generation, protocol freeze, or cloud action.
checks: All spacing-only rows selected mechanically with the mandatory other-metric row, explicit shams and excluded failure counts.
1024 genuine physical input histories use the unchanged prepare_family helper; nested256/512/1024 samples select actual states and never interpolate hidden states.
Shared128 headings, physical histories, goal/code/action/reward and common future inputs require exact identity; only CNN embedding differences use the declared1e-5 absolute tolerance.

Prepared-input manifest binds to archived source summary; original bank/census/source closure and original/fixed-final checkpoint provenance are authenticated; every changed checkpoint reconstructs its own complete native prefix.
Original geometry and recovery helpers are reused unchanged; both512 and1024 must pass plus initial/evolved polygon convergence within0.005 initial radius.

Eight equal physical-angle anchors span the circle at both densities; all20 normal directions, both signs and tangent controls remain; legal hidden-state bounded followups and inconclusive outcomes are retained.
Raw and h/c-RMS recovery conjunction remains mandatory; forward/backward sections remain distinct.
Complete cohort ledgers and partial artifacts are retained on timeout; no selective retry or silent row/density deletion.
Positive steep-ring, finest-only rejection, shrinking-plane and collapsed-point controls, midpoint-wiggle convergence, physical-input and alias/timeout regressions pass.
